transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well... what brought me in is that I’m just so worn out. It’s hard to really explain, but... just walking from the bedroom to the kitchen feels like I've been hauling lumber all day. And resting doesn’t help. I can lie down for hours, but it doesn’t give me anything back. I'm just completely drained.
Have you been feeling down or depressed?

Yeah, I have. It's... well, every morning I wake up with this heavy, hopeless feeling right in my chest. It just sits there. And some days, I'll just go out and sit in the garage and cry... and I don't even really know what started it. I just feel incredibly down.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I have. I used to really look forward to things... singing in the choir, playing pickup ball, working on cars. I always liked grilling for the family, too. But now, I just... I can't make myself care enough to do any of it. I don't show up anymore, and I can't even bring myself to answer people's texts when they reach out. The interest just isn't there.
After you do even a small amount of activity, do you feel significantly worse afterward?

Not really... I mean, I don't think I feel worse. It's more that I'm already so drained before I even try to do anything. Doing a small chore or walking around doesn't make me crash harder afterward, it's just... it's just really hard to do in the first place. I stay at just about the same level of exhausted the whole time.
Have you had a period like this before in your life?
No, I... I don't think so. I've never felt anything like this before. I mean, everyone has bad days, but this is... this is completely different. It's never been this bad or lasted like this.
How has your sleep been lately?

I don't really know, honestly. I haven't noticed anything... specific about my sleep. I guess I'm just so tired all the time anyway, it all sort of blurs together. I couldn't tell you if it's better or worse or what.
Have you been worrying a lot lately, even about everyday things?

No, not really. I don't think I even have the energy to worry right now. Everyday things just sort of... happen, or they don't. I haven't really been anxious or worrying about them, I just don't have it in me to care that much.
Have you noticed a change in your appetite lately?

No, I haven't really noticed a change. I mean... I haven't been paying much attention to it, to be honest. I guess I just eat when I need to, but nothing really stands out as being different with my appetite.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of killing yourself?
Yeah... I have. The thought just keeps coming up that I should just be dead. And honestly, when I'm alone, it scares me. I start thinking that I might actually do something to make that happen.
Do you have a specific plan for how you would kill yourself?

No... no, I don't have a plan. I haven't really thought about exactly how I would do it. It's more just... the thoughts are there, that I shouldn't be here anymore. But I haven't figured out a specific way or anything like that.
Have you felt like your body or your thinking has been moving unusually slowly lately?

Yeah, I have. Everything I do has slowed down a lot. It feels like my body is moving through mud. And... when people ask me something, I can hear the question just fine, but it takes me a really long time to actually get the words out.
Have you been feeling unusually sensitive to cold lately?
No... I haven't really noticed anything like that. I don't think I've been any colder than usual.
Have you been constipated lately?
No... I don't think so. I haven't had any trouble going to the bathroom or anything like that. That part has been pretty normal.
Do you get short of breath بسهولة when you exert yourself, like walking across the room or climbing stairs?
No, not really. I mean, I don't move around a whole lot right now, but... my breathing seems fine. I don't get winded just walking across the room or doing the stairs.
